ITEM 1 | Golden-brown seared piece with darker charred spots and a slightly glossy, crisp-looking surface, roughly oval and domed, about 6 cm by 4 cm and 2.5 cm tall, sitting at the left of the food cluster on the white square plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Shredded, pale grayish-brown stringy meat with dark bits and a moist, fibrous texture, forming a mound about 8 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm tall, mixed with pale strands and flecks of orange, located center-right of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-colored shredded strands, possibly soft and tender, with slight sheen, about 4 cm long clustered in the center of the mound, sitting among the brown shredded meat | 25
ITEM 4 | Small piece of purplish-red thin sliver, about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying on the right edge of the shredded mixture | 5
ITEM 5 | Small sprig of bright green leafy herb, flat leaves about 3 cm across, lying at the far left edge touching the golden piece | 3
